1719-4613-6857.easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1719-4613-6857.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1719-4613-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

560-2034-5189.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
560-2034-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

4247-6199-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

628-6495-7217.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7217.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

862-1003-5860-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.

862-1003-5860-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2292-3240-5632-6462.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token, Clue token and creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4125-4377-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2820-4679-7297.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

3259-4689-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4559-4779-5272-6757.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4779-5272-6757.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-3108-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
2511-3108-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

2275-2510-3532-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2275-2510-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3661-4050-5220-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

618-3580-6797.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3362-4865.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter
3362-4865.description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Shapeshifter's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

372-3680-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Stunt Double.
372-3680-4681.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Stunt Double's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Stunt Double ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Stunt Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Stunt Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1477-2018-2111.easyPrerequisites:
You control a black creature.
You do not control a blue creature.
1477-2018-2111.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Wingrattle Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2292-3951-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2292-3951-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

372-4598-4823.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Timeless Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
372-4598-4823.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

997-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
997-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
997-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

944-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1238-2570-3273-5964-5965.description:
Activate Command Beacon's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Lord Windgrace into your hand from the command zone.
Activate Archaeological Dig's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Planebound Accomplice by paying {R}, putting Lord Windgrace from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Lord Windgrace's second ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Archaeological Dig and Command Beacon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability twice by removing two loyalty counters from Lord Windgrace, turning it into a creature
Lord Windgrace goes to the graveyard due to having zero loyalty coutners.
Choose to return Lord Windgrace to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

228-628-4929.manaNeeded: {1} if Cryptic Trilobite does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
228-628-4929.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat step 1 until Cryptic Trilobite does not have any +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Cryptic Trilobite.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering its undying ability and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Cryptic Trilobite trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

1248-3388-3476.description:
Cast Harald Unties the Elves by paying {2}{B}{G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
Harald Unites the Elves' first chapter ability triggers, causing you to mill three cards, and return Moritte from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harald Unites the Elves with one lore counter on it.
Moritte of the Frost's first chapter ability triggers, holding priority, activate Phantatog's first ability by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, causing you to mill three cards, and return Moritte from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harald Unites the Elves with one lore counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

221-1012-1116-3977-4818-5231.description:
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {2}.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Wild Pair.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Wild Pair trigger, searching your library for Endurance and putting it onto the battlefield.
Endurance enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Endurance, adding {R}.
Endurance dies, triggering Sek'Kuar, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Endurance trigger from step 5, causing you to put all cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Graveborn, adding {R}.
Repeat.

614-1987-2427-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
614-1987-2427-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
